en: Your sentence was not added because it already exists.
zh: 您无法添加这个句子，因为以下句子已经存在。

en: Your sentence was not added because the following already exists.
zh: 您无法添加这个句子，因为以下句子已经存在。

en: Your sentences were like a green meadow in winter.
zh: 你的话语就像在冬天的绿色草甸一样。

en: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
zh: 你妹妹看上去那么高贵，就像是个公主一样。

en: Your sneakers are dirty; take them off before you come in.
zh: 你的运动鞋太脏了，进来前脱掉。

en: Your team is very good, but theirs is the best.
zh: 你们是个非常好的团队，但他们的是最好的。

en: Your waistcoat is inside out. Put it on the right way round.
zh: 你的背心里外反了，来翻出来。

en: Zailaiba Bar is hiring waiters; are you interested?
zh: “再来吧”酒吧要招一个服务员，你有兴趣吗？

en: Zamenhof, the creator of Esperanto, was an ophthalmologist.
zh: 世界语的创始人柴门霍夫是一个眼科医生。

en: Ziri still has much to learn in this world we live in.
zh: 这世上还有很多东西是吉理不明白的。

en: A bird is known by its note, and a man by his talk.
zh: 听其声而知其鸟，闻其声而知其人。

en: A book not worth reading is not worth buying in the first place.
zh: 一本不值得读的书，一开始就不应该买。

en: A complicated job like that can't be done in the blink of an eye.
zh: 如此复杂的工作决不能毕其功于一役。

en: A democrat is a free citizen who yields to the will of the majority.
zh: 民主主义者是屈服于大部分人的自由公民。

en: A goatherd drove his goats, all white with snow, into a deserted cave for shelter.
zh: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。

en: A good book can completely absorb your attention, to the extent that you forget your surroundings and even your existence.
zh: 一本好书会令你全神贯注，甚至忘掉周围和自己。

en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.
zh: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。

en: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.
zh: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。

en: A lady's imagination is very rapid; it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony, in a moment.
zh: 女人的思维很有跳跃性：从仰慕到爱慕，从爱慕到结婚都是一眨眼间的事。

en: A large quantity of air-conditioners has been sold since the temperature is high.
zh: 因为气温很高，有大量空调售出。

en: A lawyer is a person who prevents someone else from getting your money.
zh: 律师是防止别人拿你的钱的人。

en: A lot of people can't go home for Lunar New Year because of the pandemic.
zh: 因疫情许多人不能回家过春节。

en: A man can no more become a woman than a monkey can develop into a man.
zh: 男人不能变成女人，就像猴子不能进化成人类一样。

en: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.
zh: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

en: A more experienced lawyer would have dealt with the case in a different way.
zh: 一个经验丰富的律师会以其它方法来处理这个情形的。

en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

en: A person is a bachelor if and only if that person is a marriageable man who has never married.
zh: 当且仅当一个人是个没有结婚并可以结婚的男人，那个人是个未娶。

en: A person who hates creates his own hell, but a person who loves has heaven within.
zh: 一个充满了恨的人为自己创造了地狱，而一个拥有爱的人心中存在着天堂。

en: A revolution is an insurrection, an act of violence by which one class overthrows another.
zh: 革命就是一场暴动，一场由一个阶级推翻另一个阶级的暴力行动。

en: A reward will be paid to anyone who brings back the money that he lost.
zh: 凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。

en: A shepherd drove his snow-covered goat into an abandoned cave to take shelter from the blizzard.
zh: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。

en: A small road ran across the bridge, through the fields, and over a hill.
zh: 一条小路跨过桥梁，穿过田野，还爬上小丘。

en: A sports bra should only be worn for working out, and not in any non-sports situations.
zh: 运动内衣最好只在运动时穿着，在其他非运动场合不穿。

en: A true German can't stand the French, yet willingly he drinks their wines.
zh: 一个真正的德国人无法忍受法国人，但他很愿意喝他们的酒。

en: A user should have freedom with respect to both hardware and software. An operating system should be open, not closed.
zh: 用户应该拥有硬件和软件的使用自由，操作系统应该是开放的，而不是封闭的。

en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
zh: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。

en: A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.
zh: 汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。

en: A woman brought an old picture of her dead husband, wearing a hat, to the photographer.
zh: 一位妇女带了一张旧照片给摄影师，照片上是她过世的丈夫，她的丈夫戴着一顶帽子。

en: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.
zh: 伯拉罕·林肯，美国第16任总统，生于肯塔基州的一个简陋的小屋里。

en: According to one study, Amazon's sales go down by 1% for every 100-millisecond lag in its loading times.
zh: 有研究称，打开速度每慢100毫秒，Amazon 的销售额就下降1%。

en: According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
zh: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

en: According to the latest census, the language's number of speakers appears to be stable, or even increasing.
zh: 根据最新的人口普查，语言的发言人人数好像稳定，或者是甚至在上升。

en: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
zh: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。

en: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
zh: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

en: After a long day of looking at a computer, don't you feel tired?
zh: 一天到晚对着电脑，你不觉得厌倦吗？

en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
zh: 经过多年的刻苦训练，她终于破茧成蝶，赢得了冠军。

en: After the assistant returned $1 to each one, each man had actually paid only $9.
zh: 然后助手还给每人1美金，每个人实际上只付了9美金。

en: After washing, the cat's fur is soft and fluffy, and has a faint scent.
zh: 洗过澡后，猫咪的毛柔软又蓬松，还有淡淡的香味。

en: Ah, I forgot to ask. Before you said you hadn't seen the umbrella. Have you found it since?
zh: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

en: All humans are equal and independent. No one can damage another's life, health, freedom, and property.
zh: 一切人都是平等和独立的，没有人有权损害另一个人的生命、健康、自由和财产。

en: All of the longing and wishes for good fortune are wrapped up in the fragile skin of the dumplings.
zh: 所有的思念与祝福都包进了那薄薄的饺子皮里。

en: All the villagers went into the mountains to look for a missing cat.
zh: 所有村民出发去山里寻找一只失踪的猫。

en: All the wealth in the world is useless when death comes knocking on your door.
zh: 当死亡来敲你的门时，世界上所有的财富都是无用的。

en: All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.
zh: 这些新模块毫无疑问会影响主页的加载速度。

en: All you have to do is push this button to take a picture.
zh: 你要做的就是按这个按钮拍照。

en: All you have to do is to write your name and address here.
zh: 你只要在这里写下你的姓名和地址就行了。

en: Almost all the American TV series of the last few years were written by homosexuals.
zh: 这几年美剧的编剧几乎都是同性恋。

en: Almost half the men in Great Britain regularly give chocolate to their partner, especially for their birthday.
zh: 大部分大不列颠的男人定期送巧克力作礼物给他们的配偶，尤其是在他们生日的时候。

en: Alrighty kids! So for this art project, all of you guys will split into groups of 3 - 5 people.
zh: 好了孩子们！所以为了这个美术计划，你们所有人都将被分离并加入3-5人的小组

en: Although he did well in the exam, his spoken Chinese is not necessarily as good as yours.
zh: 虽然他考得很好，他口语的汉语不见得比你的好。

en: Although his exam scores weren't very high, he was still successful after graduation.
zh: 尽管他考试成绩不高，但他毕业后还是很成功。

en: Although it seems very difficult to study Chinese, it's not as hard as you think.
zh: 尽管中文学起来不容易，可是比你想的简单。

en: Although the decision to implement this plan has already been made, the finer points still need to be planned out.
zh: 这个计划虽然已经决定实施了，但是具体细节还需要从长计议。

en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

en: Although the life of Chinese people is getting better and better now, there is still room for improvement.
zh: 尽管现在中国人的生活越来越好了，可是还有改进的余地。

en: Americans are said to regard the amount of money a man makes as a criterion of his ability.
zh: 据说美国人把一个人的收入视为评判他能力的重要尺度。

en: An ambassador is an honest man sent to lie abroad for the good of his country.
zh: 大使是为了本国的利益被派去外国撒谎的正直的人。

en: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
zh: 专家就是一个能够把所有的错误控制在最小范围内的人。

en: An idea not properly analyzed is not worth exploiting, just as a life without self-judgment is not worth living.
zh: 没有经过仔细审视的观念是不值得拥有的，正如没有经过仔细审视的生活不值得过一样。

en: An intellectual is a person who has discovered something more interesting than sex.
zh: 一个知识分子是发现到一种比性行为更有意思的活动的人。

en: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.
zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。

en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.
zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

en: Any student of this school must learn one more foreign language besides English.
zh: 除了英语，这个学校的所有学生必须多学一门外语。

en: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

en: Anyway the event has already passed, there is no point in mentioning it again.
zh: 反正事情已过去了，那不用再提了。

en: Anyway, at the age of 22 one knows everything, so what's the use of reading?
zh: 反正到了二十二岁什么都知道了，看书还有什么用呢。

en: Apple is still very secretive with regard to the release date and the price.
zh: 苹果在发售日期和价格上口风仍然很紧。

en: Are there any aspects of Shanghai that are not as good as those of Beijing?
zh: 上海有什么不如北京的方面吗？

en: Are there any markets or supermarkets around here? Is it convenient for daily shopping?
zh: 这儿周围有没有小菜场跟大型超市，买生活用品方便吗？

en: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?
zh: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？

en: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
zh: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。

en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
zh: 由于一些工厂使用矿物燃料，化学品的排放已经产生严重的环境问题。

en: As a result of the server breakdown, total PV of yesterday dropped by 30% compared with normal.
zh: 由于服务器故障，昨天的总PV与正常相比下降了30%。

en: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.
zh: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。

en: As figures from the National Development and Reform Committee show, the Internet has developed rapidly in rural China.
zh: 来自国家发展和改革委员会的数据显示，互联网在中国农村地区发展迅猛。

en: As human beings are social animals, friendship is an essential part of life.
zh: 因为人类是一种群居动物，所以友情是生活里面一个必要的方面。

en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
zh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

en: As long as it's not a fatal mistake, it is ok to fail.
zh: 只要不是致命性的错误，失败也没关系。

en: As much as 90 percent of happiness comes from elements such as attitude, life control and relationships.
zh: 高达百分之九十的快乐来自看法、生活控制、关系等因素。

en: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
zh: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

en: As the moon rises above the sea, we share the same time though we are far apart.
zh: 海上升明月，天涯共此时。

en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
zh: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

en: As the trees crave tranquility in the ever-persistent wind, the child craves the care of its ever-absent parents.
zh: 树欲静而风不息，子欲养而亲不在！

en: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
zh: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。

en: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.
zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。

en: As usual the Spanish team are showing off their skills at one-touch football.
zh: 西班牙队像往常一样炫耀他们一脚传球的球技。

en: As you look at your face, you try to figure out what is happening behind it, in your mind.
zh: 当你看着自己的脸时，你会试图去发现这张脸后面的心灵里在发生着什么。

en: At first there will be many unrecognized words and grammatical forms, but don't be scared.
zh: 一开始会有很多不认识的单词和语法形式，但是不要害怕。

en: At first, he thought English very difficult, but now he thinks it is easy.
zh: 起初他以为英语很难，如今他觉得很简单。

en: At that time, the two main schools of thought in psychology were behaviourism and psychoanalysis.
zh: 在那个年代，心理学的两个主要学派是行为主义学派与精神分析学派。

en: At the end of April, the water of the Yellow River had darkened.
zh: 四月底，黄河的水发黑了。

en: At the end of the first half Real Madrid were in the lead, but Chelsea won in the end.
zh: 皇家马德里在上半场处于领先，但切尔西最终赢得了比赛。

en: At the entrance of a Japanese house, visitors are generally asked to take off their shoes.
zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

en: At The Happiness Institute in Australia, a couple of hundred dollars may do the trick.
zh: 在澳大利亚的快乐协会，两百块钱可能达到效果。

en: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
zh: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。

en: Because all of the teams in the Premier League are really strong, the goal difference is usually small.
zh: 因为在甲级联赛中，所有队伍都很有实力，净胜球差异很小。

en: Because I left early this morning, I couldn't use my computer, so I used my phone to send messages.
zh: 因为今早要出门，不能用电脑，所以用手机发信息。

en: Because it had been raining for a couple of days, the pitch was muddy and difficult to play on.
zh: 球队已经训练了几天，所以这个足球场有些泥泞，不太好用了。

en: Because it's a developing country, some aspects of China aren't as good as those in Western countries.
zh: 因为中国是个发展中的国家，所以有的方面没有西方国家那么好。

en: Because of the change in Canadian marriage laws, many American homosexuals came to Canada to get married.
zh: 由于加拿大婚姻法的改变，所以很多美国同性恋者去了加拿大结婚。

en: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
zh: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

en: Beethoven goes to the piano, sits down at it, and begins to play.
zh: 贝多芬走向钢琴，坐下来并开始弹。

en: Before the 15th century it was generally believed that the Earth was at the centre of the universe.
zh: 在15世纪以前，人们曾经普遍认为地球位于宇宙的中心。

en: Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.
zh: 他家后面有小溪，清可见底。

en: Being unfamiliar with foreign languages, you'll never be able to understand the foreigner's silence.
zh: 没有对外语的认识，你永远无法理解外国人的沉默。

en: Better to be hated for who you are than loved for who you're not.
zh: 宁愿做自己而被人讨厌，也不要因为虚假而被人喜欢。

en: Black people had to sit in the back of the bus, or stand if the back was full.
zh: 黑人不得不坐在公交车的后面，如果后面的座位满了则只能站在那里。

en: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.
zh: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

en: Bob gave Tina almost all the stamps he had collected, and kept only a few for himself.
zh: 鲍勃几乎把他所收集的所有邮票给了缇娜，只留了一点给他自己。

en: Borrow and return, then you can borrow again. Borrow and don't return, and then the borrowing gets difficult.
zh: 有借有还，再借不难。有借不还，再借就难。

en: Bring two breakfasts, please. Number 2 on the menu, and two teas with milk.
zh: 请送两份早餐过来。2号餐加两杯奶茶。

en: By switching your lover from 3D to 2D, you may successfully reduce all social-interaction-related costs.
zh: 把恋人从3D换成2D可以有效地降低交际所需的费用。

en: By the time that he tried 966, Dima was beginning to give up hope.
zh: 当迪马尝试了打九六六的时候， 他开始了放弃希望。

en: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
zh: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

en: By the way, may I ask when in the evening your restaurant opens?
zh: 顺便问一下，餐厅晚上几点钟开始营业？

en: Can we please have two cups of tea and one cup of coffee?
zh: 请来两杯茶和一杯咖啡。

en: Can you produce any evidence that he was not at home that night?
zh: 你能不能提供他那天晚上没在家的证明？

en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.
zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。

en: Cheese is a solid food made from the milk of cows, goats, sheep, and other mammals.
zh: 奶酪是由母牛、山羊、绵羊或其它哺乳动物的奶加工制成的固体食物。

en: China is a sleeping tiger, but once it wakes up, it will shock the world.
zh: 中国是一只沉睡的狮子，一旦觉醒，将会震惊世界。

en: China is perhaps the only country in the world where the temperature is controlled by the government.
zh: 中国也许是世界上唯一一个由政府控制温度的国家。

en: China's health authorities are taking steps to stop the spread of the coronavirus.
zh: 中国的卫生当局正在采取措施来阻止冠状病毒的传播。

en: Christopher Columbus wasn't an explorer because he loved the sea. He was an explorer because he hated Spanish jails.
zh: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布之所以成为探险家，不是因为他热爱大海，而是因为他讨厌西班牙的监狱。

en: Compare it to other enjoyable activities: going to the cinema, reading books, going for walks, chatting to friends etc.
zh: 把它相较于其他有意思的活动：去电影院，看书，散步，跟朋友聊天等等。

en: Country girls like to cut red paper into peach and plum blossoms and paste them onto doors and windows.
zh: 农村的女孩喜欢把红色的纸裁减成桃和李的花及贴在门窗上。

en: Crossing guards are posted during school hours to guide children safely across busy streets.
zh: 在学校上课期间会设置过马路警察以引导小孩安全地穿过繁忙的街道。

en: Data compression algorithms can be classified in two categories: those with data loss and those without data loss.
zh: 压缩数据的算法能分为两种：一种会造成数据损失，另一种则不会。

en: Deep down, everyone is rich and beautiful, but we don't know how to express it!
zh: 内心世界很丰富，不知该如何表达了！

en: Departure is a partial death but death in essence is not only departure.
zh: 离开是部分的死亡，而死亡不仅仅是离开。

en: Despite the fact that he has only just started learning Chinese, he already knows lots of characters.
zh: 尽管他是一周前才开始学中文的，然而他已经认识很多字了。

en: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.
zh: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。

en: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.
zh: 这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。

en: It's just that because he hasn't made something of himself, his father won't look at him.
zh: 就是因为他不成材他爸看不起他。

en: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
zh: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。

en: It's one thing to make plans, but quite another to carry them out.
zh: 做计划是一码事，付诸实践是另一码事。

en: It's raining outside. Don't forget to close the windows when you get back home.
zh: 外面下雨了，记得回家把窗关上。

en: It's really cold today. You should dress warmer or you might catch a cold.
zh: 今天天气很冷，您多穿衣服吧，要不然会感冒的。

en: It's when you teach foreigners Chinese that you realize just how flawed your own Chinese is.
zh: 教外国人中文的时候才会发现自己中文有多差。

en: James had a great fear of making mistakes in class and being reprimanded.
zh: 詹姆斯怕极了在课堂上犯错并被训斥。

en: Jiang Feng's servant hired the "Twelve Zodiacs" to kill him. They ambushed him and his wife Yuenu.
zh: 江枫的仆人雇了十二生肖杀江枫，他们伏击了江枫和江枫的妻子月奴。

en: Jonathan was booked because he got into a fight with a player on the other team.
zh: 乔纳森吃牌了，因为与对方球员打架。

en: Judging from current situations, this task will not be finished until next week.
zh: 根据现在的情况，这个任务在下周之前无法结束。

en: Just because a certain book does not interest readers does not mean that the fault lies in the book.
zh: 不是因为读者对某本书不感兴趣，这本书就肯定是有问题的了。

en: Just then, the workers in the park brought over some small playing cards.
zh: 这时候公园里的工人拿来了一些小纸牌。

en: Kids these days think that any issue in life can be resolved as easily as restarting a computer game.
zh: 现在的孩子认为解决任何生活问题都像重新开始一个电脑游戏那么简单。

en: Knowing That the Mountain has tigers, so don't go to Knowing That the Mountain.
zh: 明知山有虎，別去明知山。

en: Kobayashi's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.
zh: 小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。

en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
zh: 最近一直在舞蹈排练，周五周六要演出啊。

en: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can never live long enough to make them all yourself.
zh: 从别人的错误中学习，因为你无法所有事都亲身经历一次。

en: Learning about the way the Earth has formed is a very interesting thing.
zh: 学习地球的形成过程是很有趣的一件事。

en: Life is like a marathon, where short-term gains and losses are not significant in and of themselves.
zh: 人生是一次长跑，暂时的落后和领先都不算什么。

en: Lionel Messi is one of the best strikers in the world. He has scored the most goals ever for Barcelona.
zh: 里奥· 梅西是世界上最杰出的前锋之一，他是巴塞罗那进球最多的球员。

en: Little Wang is on maternity leave. She won't be back to work for six months.
zh: 小王休产假了，半年内都不会来上班。

en: London is such a large city that visitors must use buses and the underground railway to get about.
zh: 伦敦是个大城市，游客必须乘公交或地铁才能出行。

en: Look at him. He looks like an idiot but he's also very cute.
zh: 你看他傻乎乎的模样，倒也挺可爱。

en: Look guys, the window and even the kitchen door have both been left open!
zh: 你们看，窗开着，厨房门也没关！

en: Look, look! On the branch of the orange tree, there is a blue hermit crab!
zh: 快看快看！橙子树的树枝上有一只蓝色的寄居蟹！

en: Luciano might have the crowd behind him, but he's still wet behind the ears.
zh: 虽然Luciano可能已经是出类拔萃，但他还是乳臭未干。

en: Lucy might be able to help you, if you can't cook dinner for ten people alone.
zh: 露西也许能帮你的忙，如果你一人做不来十个人的晚饭。

en: Make a good translation of the sentence that you are translating. Don't let translations into other languages influence you.
zh: 请给您所译的句子一个良好的翻译。请勿让其他语言的翻译影响到您所做的翻译。

en: Managing your stocks with Big Wisdom shows that you are serious about investing!
zh: 用大智慧做股票，说明您对投资是认真的！

en: Mandarin, English, and Arabic are all examples of the world's most widely spoken languages.
zh: 汉语也好，英语也好，阿拉伯语也好，都属于世界上最多人用的语言。

en: Mangroves absorb more carbon dioxide than any other trees on Earth because they have large underground root structures.
zh: 红树林吸取二氧化碳比地球上其他树木都要多，因为它们具有很大的地下根部结构。

en: Mangroves sequester more carbon than any other trees on Earth because they have quite a large underground root structure.
zh: 红树林吸取二氧化碳比地球上其他树木都要多，因为它们具有很大的地下根部结构。

en: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
zh: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。

en: Many people can't, and do not want to, make the effort to understand others.
zh: 许多人不能而且不想去理解别人。

en: Mary came home from school in tears because her friends had teased her.
zh: 玛丽哭着从学校跑回了家里，因为她的朋友捉弄了她。

en: Mary had become so frail and gaunt that it seemed she already had one foot in the grave.
zh: 玛丽变得如此虚弱和憔悴，似乎她的一只脚已经踏进了坟墓。

en: Mary said she thought she might have to do that before she can go home.
zh: 玛丽说她以为必须先完成这件事才能回家。

en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
zh: 玛丽把围裙系在她的腰上，然后把火鸡从烤箱里拿出来了。

en: Mary told Tom that she couldn't do what he asked her to do.
zh: 玛丽告诉汤姆她做不了他要求的事情。

en: Messi was very close to scoring a goal, but the referee blew his whistle to say that he was offside.
zh: 梅西差一点就进球了，但裁判吹哨说他越位。

en: Miss Wang has a trace of obstinacy in her, but she is still a good student.
zh: 王小姐有一点固执，但是她还算是一个好学生。

en: Modern healthy eating experts put emphasis on eating wholemeal bread and eating more vegetables.
zh: 现代的健康饮食专家强调要吃全麦面包，多吃蔬菜。

en: More and more environmentalists advocate and use environmentally friendly unleaded petrol in cars.
zh: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。

en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
zh: 越来越多的女人拥有自己的事业并实现和丈夫的经济独立。

en: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
zh: 一个网页超过百分之九十的访问量是来自于搜索引擎的。

en: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.
zh: 大部分程序员讨厌调试，设置故障比纠正它们有意思多了。

en: Most letters from his wife were read to him by the nurse in the hospital.
zh: 他住院时，大部分太太给他写的信由护士读给他听。

en: Most students agree with the proposal and have made a list of arguments in favour of it.
zh: 大多数学生同意这个建议，并列出了他们同意的理由。

en: Music is inner life, and he will never suffer loneliness who has inner life.
zh: 音乐是内心世界，拥有了内心世界的他永远不会觉得孤独。

en: My mother stood for awhile, then sighed as she returned to her room.
zh: 母亲又站了一会，然后叹着气回到了自己的房间。

en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.
zh: 本地人、外来人齐心共创上海新文明。

en: Neither he nor she wants to do the dishes, and so the two of them decided to eat out.
zh: 他也不想洗碗，她也不想洗碗，所以他们决定出去吃。

en: No hobby is as cheap as reading, nor provides such long lasting enjoyment.
zh: 没有任何娱乐像阅读这般廉价，也没有任何愉悦像阅读这般持久。

en: No man has the imagination required to grasp female reason, which is why it is called unreasonable.
zh: 没有男人有能把控住女性理性的想象力，这就是为什么它被说无理。

en: No matter how important the question may or may not be, you must solve it.
zh: 不管这个问题重不重要，你必须解决它。

en: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.
zh: 不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。

en: No matter what grand and lofty reason you have, it's not right to do this.
zh: 不管你有什么冠冕堂皇的理由，这样做是不对的。

en: No need to trouble yourself, Auntie. A glass of boiled water will be plenty.
zh: 阿姨，您别客气，喝杯开水就行。

en: No one man can answer what's the meaning of life; this question stands before all mankind.
zh: 没有一个人能回答出生命的意义是什么；这个问题就摆在全人类面前。

en: No person by that name is listed in the register of the school.
zh: 学校的名册里没有这个名字的人。

en: No wonder she doesn't want to see him again. Because they broke up.
zh: 难怪她表示不想再见到他了。因为他们分手了。

en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

en: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
zh: 不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。

en: Not wanting to is the reason; not being able to is just an excuse.
zh: 不想做是原因；不能做仅仅是接口。

en: Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, difficulty.
zh: 世间没有一种具有真正价值的东西，可以不 经过艰苦辛勤的劳动而能够得到的。

en: Nothing lasts forever, not for a long time, anyone can find an excuse to go ahead.
zh: 没有什么永远，没有什么很久，找个借口谁都可以先走。

en: Now that we've bought new furniture for the room, why not throw away this old, worn-out furniture?
zh: 既然房间里新家具都买好了，这点破家具都可以丢掉了！

en: Now's the time to decide whether you really want to get married or not.
zh: 现在是你决定是不是真要结婚的时候。

en: Nowadays, some kindergartens are carrying out bilingual teaching, and so all the children can speak a little English.
zh: 现在有些幼儿园推行的是双语教学，小朋友们都能滴里嘟噜地说上几句英语。

en: Obviously, this cannot be the work of one person. This is why Tatoeba is collaborative.
zh: 很明显，这不可能是一个人的工作。这就是为什么Tatoeba是一个合作项目。

en: Of course, another explanation of this situation is that Chinese is harder to learn than English.
zh: 当然，对这个情况的另一个解释是中文比英文难学。

en: Of these, Taoism is a native religion, the others having been introduced from foreign lands.
zh: 其中，道教是本国的，其他是从国外引进的。

en: On a rainy morning, he left his house early so as to be in time for school.
zh: 在一个下雨的早晨，他很早出门为的是及时到学校。

en: On March 1, President Donald Trump has signed an executive order making English the official language of the United States.
zh: 3 月 1 日，唐纳德・特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，将英语定为美国的官方语言。

en: On Mid-Autumn Day, families gather, eat moon cake together, and watch the moon.
zh: 在中秋节，家人团聚，一起吃月饼、赏月。

en: On some OS's you get gibberish for filenames with full-width characters so when downloading please change to a suitable filename.
zh: 一些操作系统上有全角字符的文件名会显示为乱码，所以下载时请改成适当的文件名。

en: On the 25th, the Chinese government issued a white paper entitled "The Diaoyu Islands are China's Inherent Territory".
zh: 25日，中国政府发布《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。

en: Once bitten by a snake, one is afraid of a well rope for ten years.
zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳。

en: Once he got the news of his daughter-in-law's death, he totally freaked out.
zh: 一到他知道儿子妇女的死亡的消息，他会暴跳如雷。

en: Once the work is done, usually around half past five, I come home to have dinner.
zh: 做完工作一般是五点半回到家里吃晚饭。

en: Once you do it, you see that it's not as hard as it sounds.
zh: 这件事做起来没有听着这么难。

en: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

en: Once you've formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
zh: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。

en: One hundred, two hundred, three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred, nine hundred, one thousand.
zh: 一百， 二百， 三百， 四百， 五百， 六百， 七百， 八百， 九百， 一千。

en: One must have conviction in law, or its existence will be superficial only.
zh: 法律必须被信仰，否则形同虚设。

en: One needs to do their best in all things, and more importantly work within their abilities.
zh: 凡事要尽力而为，更要量力而行。

en: One should not be scared of poverty, and instead, be determined amidst it.
zh: 人不要怕穷，要穷中立志.

en: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.
zh: 只有你好好学习才可以考得上大学。

en: Only when the Party Committee Secretary came in person to resolve it was this point of view dispelled entirely.
zh: 直到党委书记出面加以解释，才算打消了这种想法。

en: Opera in English is, in the main, just about as sensible as baseball in Italian.
zh: 以英语唱的歌剧，大致上和以意大利语玩的棒球般过得去。

en: Operation Yoav was a military operation carried out by Israel in its war for independence.
zh: 约阿夫行动是以色列独立战争中的一次作战行动。

en: Other requirements come from your relationships with other people and your daily activities.
zh: 其它的要素来自你跟别人的关系和你平日的活动。

en: Otherwise, it is considered impolite to pass food with the left hand, because the left hand is used for bathing.
zh: 否则，用左手传递食物会被认为是不礼貌的，因为左手是用来洗澡的。

en: Our sister bought some eggplants, potatoes, zucchinis and Chinese cabbage at the market.
zh: 姐姐在市场买了一点茄子、土豆、丝瓜和大白菜。

en: Outside of working hours, you can get a hold of him through his private phone.
zh: 工作时间以外，可以打他的私人电话找到他。

en: Over and over again, he read the letter she had mailed him, but he still did not understand it.
zh: 他反复读了好几遍她寄来的信，还是没明白她的意思。

en: Over the last hundred years, there have been twenty-seven recorded deaths from spider bites in Australia.
zh: 过去一百多年，澳大利亚共有二十七例蜘蛛咬人致死的记录。

en: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.
zh: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。

en: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
zh: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。

en: Parts of the world that are already hot enough might become unbearably so.
zh: 世界上已经够热的地方会变得让人无法忍受。

en: Passing through the strong wind, the planes rock like this, but don't worry.
zh: 当飞机穿越强风时，它们会像这样摇晃，但是别担心。

en: People could not see any hopes of obtaining happiness in this life, thus they instinctively sought comfort in the afterlife.
zh: 人们在此世中看不到任何获得幸福的希望，便很本能地想在彼世中寻求慰藉。

en: People eagerly sought a more modernised style of dress and transformed the old qipao to suit their tastes.
zh: 人们热切地寻求更有现代风格的衣服，所以把以前的旗袍改成了适合他们品位的东西。

en: People from the so-called first world look at us Latinos as if we hadn't invented the wheel yet.
zh: 所谓的先进国家经常把拉丁美洲人看成石器时代的原始人。

en: People living on coastlines might lose their homes, and cities might be completely submerged.
zh: 住在海边的人可能失去他们的家，并且城市可能会被完全淹没。

en: People shouldn't be allowed to invade countries whose names they can't pronounce correctly.
zh: 人们不应该侵犯自己读不正确名字的国家。

en: People who are not in a hurry stand on the right side of the escalator.
zh: 不赶时间的人们站在自动扶梯的右边。

en: People who can express their thoughts in a clear-cut way are very straightforward.
zh: 能够直截了当地表达自己想法的人很直爽。

en: People who cannot find time for recreation are obliged sooner or later to find time for illness.
zh: 没工夫休息的人，早晚会有工夫生病的。

en: People who want to share their religious views with you almost never want you to share yours with them.
zh: 想要跟你分享他们宗教信仰的人几乎从不愿你跟他们分享你的。

en: Peru is the third largest country in South America after Brazil and Argentina.
zh: 秘鲁是排在巴西和阿根廷之后的南美第三大国家。

en: Philip hates traveling for away games. He always gets really tired and never plays well.
zh: 菲利普不喜欢客场比赛，他总是容易感到很疲惫。

en: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
zh: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

en: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!
zh: 请诸位斟满酒，为新郎和新娘干杯！

en: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
zh: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。

en: Please mail this letter the next time you go to the post office.
zh: 下次去邮局的时候，请把这封信寄出去。

en: Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.
zh: 快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。

en: Poor is not the one who has too little, but the one who wants too much.
zh: 贫穷的不是拥有太少的人，而是想要太多的人。

en: Possibly because he's got a beard, he looks scary at first glance but he's really a kind man.
zh: 或许是因为他有胡子而让他乍看之下很可怕，其实他是个非常好的人。

en: Prostitution, gambling, the use of narcotic substances, drunkenness, disorder, and all other illegal activities are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
zh: 严禁卖淫嫖娼，赌博，吸毒，酗酒滋事等违法犯罪活动！

en: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
zh: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

en: Read the list we sent you and check that all the sentences sound natural to you.
zh: 请把发给你的那张单子看一下，再确认一下所有的句子都很通顺。

en: Remember to check to make sure the gas has been turned off before you go out.
zh: 出门前记得检查一下煤气是否关好了。

en: Ronaldo is famous for his bicycle kick. When he does it, the fans go crazy.
zh: 罗纳尔多以他的倒勾球而闻名。当他展示倒勾球的时候，球迷们都沸腾了。

en: Ronaldo shot the ball right into the back of the net to score the winning goal.
zh: 罗纳尔多一脚射门，打进制胜一球。

en: Rooms should be left vacant by eleven a.m. on the day of departure.
zh: 走的那天，房间11点要空出来。

en: Sami has to go to his chemistry class and he will see you in Arabic.
zh: 萨米得去上他的化学课，他会用阿拉伯语和你会面。

en: Scott traded a watch for a book, and then traded the book for money.
zh: 斯科特先用一块手表换了一本书，再把书换成了钱。

en: Shanghai summers can reach temperatures of up to 38-9 degrees. That is extremely hot!
zh: 上海夏天的最高温度要到三十八九度，真快热死了！

en: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
zh: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。

en: She can't make up her mind whether to get a job or to go on to college.
zh: 她在找工作和读大学之间无法取舍。

en: She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.
zh: 她不想一直胖下去，所以正在戒吃蛋糕。

en: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
zh: 她有勇气去查询考试的结果。

en: She has a real knack for getting people to do what she wants.
zh: 她真的有本事让别人做她想做的事。

en: She has asked the person at the front desk to connect her to that number.
zh: 她请了前台的人为她打那个号码。

en: She has been ill for a long time and she is still too weak to get about.
zh: 她病了很久，现在还很虚弱，无法随意走动。

en: She has two cats. One is white and the other one is black.
zh: 她有两只猫。一只是白色的，另一只是黑色的。

en: She is not only good at running; she is also good at singing.
zh: 她不仅擅长跑步，也擅长唱歌。

en: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
zh: 她因为担心发胖而节食。

en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。

en: She once proudly stated that she was going to lose 5 kilos of fat in a single month.
zh: 她曾经夸口说一个月之内要减掉5公斤赘肉。

en: She read the letter, and so she came to learn that he was dead.
zh: 她读了信，由此得知他的死讯。

en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。

en: She said she would arrive in 5 more minutes, but she still hasn't come.
zh: 她说再过5分钟就到，但她还是没来。

en: She stood on the deck with her long hair waving in the wind.
zh: 她站在甲板上，长头发随风飞舞。

en: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
zh: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

en: She used to be a part time chef, then she became full time.
zh: 她以前是兼职厨师，后来做了全职。

en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

en: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
zh: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。

en: She was different from most women in the neighborhood, for she was able to read and write.
zh: 她和小区里大部分妇女不同，因为她会读书写字。

en: She was really upset at the time. She cried in the dorm the entire day.
zh: 她当时很伤心，在宿舍哭了整整一天。

en: She was scolded by her mother for forgetting to turn off the light when she left the house.
zh: 她因为离开家的时候忘记关灯而被妈妈说了。

en: She will only go to bed after she finishes reading this short essay.
zh: 她看完这篇短文后才会去睡觉。

en: She's the kind of person who likes to turn everything into a competition.
zh: 她是个任何事情都喜欢和别人一比高下的人。

en: Shocked by the events of September 11th, politicians all over the world condemned the terrorists for their reprehensible deed.
zh: 911事件让世人震惊，全球所有的政治家都一致谴责恐怖分子的这一应受人斥责的行径。

en: Since there is no air on the moon, there is no sound at all.
zh: 月球上没有空气，也自然没有声音。

en: Sixty minutes make an hour, and a minute is made up of sixty seconds.
zh: 六十分钟为一小时，一分钟由六十秒组成。

en: Slender and form-fitting with a high cut, the new qipao contrasted sharply with the traditional one.
zh: 新的旗袍又修长又紧身，也有短裙摆，与传统式样构成了鲜明的对比。

en: So it seems that cloud of odorless deadly gas had a silver lining after all.
zh: 只能说，致命煤气的雾团中，也定会有阳光的。

en: So many Chinese characters have been accepted into Unicode. Are all of them actually used?
zh: Unicode里收了这么多中文字符，有些真的有用吗？

en: Some people clung to tree branches for several hours to avoid being washed away by the floodwaters.
zh: 为了不被洪水冲走，有的人紧紧地抱着树干长达数个钟头。

en: Some people only buy organic food; they think that in this way their body will not be damaged by pollutants.
zh: 一些人只买有机的食物，他们认为这样可以使他们的健康不受污染的损害。

en: Some verbs in some languages can have up to one hundred different meanings.
zh: 在一些语言中，部分动词可能会有上百种不同的意思。

en: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
zh: 有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。

en: Sometimes, I wish I could walk through time, and meet myself back when I was still a child.
zh: 有时候，真希望自己可以适时的穿越回去，去见见那个还是个小孩子的自己。

en: Sometimes, you need to be alone. Not to be lonely, but to enjoy some free time just being yourself.
zh: 有时候你需要一个人呆着。不是为了感到寂寞，而是享受只做自己的自由时光。

en: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
zh: 宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。

en: St Mark's Square in Venice is always swarming with tourists in the summer.
zh: 威尼斯的圣马可广场在夏季总是挤满了游客。

en: Stories like Cinderella can be found in China, Japan and in every land of the world.
zh: 像灰姑娘这样的故事可以在中国、日本及世界任何国家都可以找到。

en: Studies show that once the basic needs of shelter and food are met, additional wealth adds very little to happiness.
zh: 研究表明人们一有住处、食物这些基本的需要，附加的财富就不能大量地提高他们的快乐。

en: Suddenly unable to make up her mind, she didn't know what to do.
zh: 她一时间拿不定主意，不知如何是好。

en: Surely he can not enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!
zh: 他当然不可能回到娘胎里再出生一次了！

en: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.
zh: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国

en: That place's food is delicious and their prices are low. However, their location isn't good.
zh: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。

en: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.
zh: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。

en: That's the thing about people who think they hate computers. What they really hate is lousy programmers.
zh: 那些自认为讨厌电脑的人就是这么回事。他们真正讨厌的是差劲的程序员。

en: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
zh: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。

en: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
zh: 一个国家纸的产量和它的文明程度密切相关。

en: The amount of people on Facebook is greater than the population of the United States of America.
zh: Facebook用户数量超过美国人口。

en: The assistant referee held up his flag to show the referee that the ball was still in play.
zh: 助理裁判向主裁判举旗示意比赛继续。

en: The authorities disclosed little useful information about the spread of COVID-19 at the beginning of the outbreak.
zh: 当局在疫情之初几乎没有透露关于新型冠状病毒的有用信息。

en: The average man fails not because he lacks ability, but because he lacks ability to concentrate.
zh: 通常人们失败并非能力不足，而是不够专注。

en: The best time to plant a tree is 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
zh: 种一棵树，最好的时间是20年前，其次是现在。

en: The best violins are made with wood from trees that have been struck by lightning.
zh: 世上最好的小提琴是用雷击木造成的。

en: The best way to know what a country is like is to go and see it with your own eyes.
zh: 了解一个国家最好的方法是亲自去看一看。

en: The best wealth is knowledge, average wealth is children, and the smallest wealth is material objects.
zh: 最好的财富是知识，一般的财富是孩子，最小的财富是物质。

en: The boy was not upset, even after being laughed at by his classmates.
zh: 即便是被同学嘲笑，那个男孩也不会感到失落。

en: The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
zh: 明年预算的计算是基于今年的成本的。

en: The child next door has to attend three different extra classes every month.
zh: 隔壁家的孩子每个月要参加3种补习班。

en: The China National Table Tennis Team had a month's closed training in winter.
zh: 中国乒乓球队进行了一个月的封闭式冬训。

en: The Chinese government controlled the internet to prevent the people from knowing the truth of the Tiananmen Square Massacre.
zh: 中国政府控制了网络，以免让人民知道六四事件的真相。

en: The Chinese government issued a white paper entitled "Diaoyu Islands are China's inherent territory" on the 25th.
zh: 25日，中国政府发布《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。

en: The chocolate is going to melt if you keep it out of the fridge.
zh: 巧克力不放在冰箱里的话会融化的。

en: The city government wants to set up special cycle lanes. However, a lot of drivers oppose the idea.
zh: 市政府想建设专门的自行车道。但是，很多司机反对这个主意。

en: The colours of the napkins are the same, but the sizes are not.
zh: 这些餐巾颜色相同，但大小不同。

en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
zh: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。

en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
zh: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。

en: The creation of most schools was not to transform society, but to reconstruct society.
zh: 大部分学校的创建不是用来转变社会，而是用来重建社会的。

en: The criterion of the scientific status of a theory is its falsifiability, or refutability, or testability.
zh: 一个理论的科学地位的标准是它的可证伪性、可反驳性或可检验性。

en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
zh: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

en: The design of these clothes is indeed rather nice, but they are a little expensive.
zh: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。

en: The difference between Facebook and Twitter is that Twitter is a microblogging service.
zh: Facebook 和 Twitter 的不同在于，Twitter 是微博服务。

en: The discovery that electric currents can be produced by magnetism is extremely important in the field of electricity.
zh: 磁能生产电流的发明，在电力领域非常重要。

en: The doctor told Mr Smith to give up smoking if he wanted to live long.
zh: 医生告诉史密斯先生他要长寿的话就得戒烟。

en: The doctors did all they could to control Tom's disease but, sadly, to no avail.
zh: 医生们尽力控制汤姆的病情了但可惜无法奏效。

en: The end product is worth ten times as much as the materials used.
zh: 最终产品值所用原材料的10倍价格。

en: The end product is worth ten times the value of the materials used.
zh: 最终产品值所用原材料的10倍价格。

en: The exam that every student failed is harder than the exam that every student passed.
zh: 所有学生都挂科的考试比所有学生都通过的考试要难。

en: The fact that television frequently limits communication within families is already well known.
zh: 电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。

en: The fact that television limits communication among family members is already widely known.
zh: 电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。

en: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
zh: 球迷们安静下来，绷紧神经，观看两支球队的点球大战。

en: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.
zh: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。

en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
zh: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

en: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
zh: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。

en: The fugitive surfaced in a small town fifty miles from here but then disappeared again.
zh: 那个逃犯在离这里五十英里的小镇上现身过后又消失了。

en: The Fuzhou Zoo in China's Fujian Province has done more than its counterparts in training pandas.
zh: 中国福建省福州市动物园在训练大熊猫方面做得比它的同行多。

en: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
zh: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

en: The government will provide interest-free loans to firms that participate in the program.
zh: 政府将会对参与该项计划的企业提供无息贷款。

en: The hand has five fingers: the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger, and the pinky.
zh: 人的手有五个手指: 拇指、食指、中指、无名指和小指。

en: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.
zh: 世界语的思想核心在于一切语言文化的平等。

en: The important thing about the Olympic Games is not to win, but to take part in them.
zh: 奥运会重要的是参与，不是获胜。

en: The king was tired of his sycophants always praising him, so he sent them away.
zh: 国王受够了他的大臣们总是对他阿谀奉承，于是把他们遣散了。

en: The languages that have been transliterated within the Tatoeba Project are Japanese, Chinese, Shanghainese, Georgian and Uzbek.
zh: Tatoeba 计划获得了音译的语言为日语、汉语、上海话、格鲁吉亚语及乌兹别克语。

en: The lie got him in trouble when his boss found out the truth.
zh: 当他的上司察觉他的谎言，麻烦来了。

en: The little girl will go astray if no one cares much about her.
zh: 这小女孩如果没人关心的话，就要走上歪路了。

en: The longer you hide your feelings for someone, the more you fall for them.
zh: 对爱掩饰得越多，愈是证明你喜欢他。

en: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

en: The main type of tree in this part of the forest is the cypress.
zh: 这片森林的树主要是柏树。

en: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.
zh: 足球教练站在边线上对自己的队伍喊出指令。

en: The meeting between the school and the business is scheduled to be held on the 26th of December.
zh: 学校与企业见面会于12月26日按期举行。

en: The modern version, which is now popularly recognized in China as the standard qipao, was first developed in Shanghai after 1900.
zh: 现在中国公认的标准旗袍的现代版本是首先在上海发展起来的。

en: The modernized version of the qipao is noted for accentuating the female figure.
zh: 现代版旗袍因能突显女人的身材而闻名。

en: The more you eat Kuqa's apricots, the more of them you'll want to eat.
zh: 库车的杏子你越吃越想吃。

en: The most beautiful thing in the sky are the stars, the most beautiful thing in life is kindness.
zh: 天上最美是星星，人生最美是溫情。

en: The most important feature of all games is that they are governed by rules.
zh: 在所有的游戏里有最重要的特点: 它们都拥有法则。

en: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part.
zh: 奥运会最重要的不是获胜，而是参与。

en: The muscles in his legs had atrophied during the seven months he was bedridden.
zh: 他的腿部肌肉在他卧床不起的七个月中萎缩了。

en: The natural landscape is characterised by its large amount of mountains, and it looks as truly beautiful as a painting.
zh: 这里的自然景观的特点是山非常多，而且像画一样特别美。

en: The natural world is always much more complex than formulations in the lab or blueprints in the design office.
zh: 自然界从来都比试验室的配方或设计院的图纸里所反映的要复杂得多。

en: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
zh: 新生小牛跟不上逃离美洲虎的牛群。

en: The news article painted the defendant as a guilty man, even though he had been proven innocent.
zh: 该报文章中将被告人描述成一个罪魁祸首，尽管他已经被证明是无辜的了。

en: The number of muffins that you'll receive will be inversely proportional to the number of times you talk on IRC.
zh: 你能得到松饼数量将和你去IRC聊天的次数成反比。

en: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
zh: 销售部门和营销部门的目标不见得一样。

en: The only thing that would have made it better is if it was cooked.
zh: 唯一美中不足的是如果它要是熟食就好了。

en: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
zh: 对方球员在禁区内组成一道防线，试图阻截梅西的射门。

en: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.
zh: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。

en: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
zh: 测试的结果显示，系统已经满足了所有设计要求。

en: The Pacific Ocean alone covers an area larger than that of all continents put together.
zh: 仅太平洋的面积就比所有的大陆的总和面积还要大。

en: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
zh: 熊猫在四川省土生土长，不在任何其他省份的野外生活。

en: The person who gets the highest salary at the company does the least work.
zh: 公司里工资最高的人，只用干最少的活。

en: The piano is a chord instrument, while the flute is a monophonic instrument.
zh: 钢琴是和弦乐器，笛子是单音乐器。

en: The pilaf with meat is eight yuan. The vegetarian pilaf is only four yuan.
zh: 抓饭肉是八块钱。素抓饭只是四块钱。

en: The plan is to recruit 5 Java engineers before the end of next month.
zh: 计划是在下月底之前招聘5名Java工程师。

en: The players sat and listened to their coach give them a pep talk in the changing rooms.
zh: 球员们坐在更衣室，听教练给他们打气。

en: The players sat in the locker room while they listened to their coach speak.
zh: 球员们坐在更衣室里听教练讲话。

en: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
zh: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。

en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
zh: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。

en: The possibility of a lack of connection between the events can be dismissed immediately.
zh: 可以立即排除事件之间缺乏关联的可能性

en: The prices of raw materials such as oil or coal continue to rise.
zh: 原材料的价格如石油或者煤的不停地上升。

en: The principal severely reproved the students whenever they made a mess in the hallway.
zh: 每次学生把走廊弄得一团糟的时候，校长都会严厉地训斥他们。

en: The problem is that the money is not of such importance as the time.
zh: 问题在于，金钱没有时间那样重要。

en: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.
zh: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。

en: The purpose of antitrust law is to stop the abusive influence of the market by big companies.
zh: 反垄断法律的目的是停止滥用市场影响力的大公司.

en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
zh: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。

en: The qipao is a classic female garment that originated in 17th century China.
zh: 旗袍是一种17世纪起源于中国的传统式样的女性服装。

en: The questions will not take long, and everything would be kept completely anonymous.
zh: 问题不需要占用很多时间，也完全不要留名。

en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

en: The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.
zh: 裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。

en: The regrettable thing is that he didn't even play at his highest level in the finals.
zh: 令人遗憾的是，他并没有在决赛发挥他的最佳水平。

en: The relationship between the mind and the heart is much like the relationship between a castle's library and its master.
zh: 心灵与心之间的关系，通常如同一个城堡的图书馆与城堡主人之间的关系一样。

en: The remark you made at the party about Lisa's weight was totally uncalled for.
zh: 你在聚会中针对Lisa体重作出的评论是完全不适当的。

en: The rent can be a bit expensive, but something nearby would be best.
zh: 租金贵一点儿没关系，近一些最好。

en: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.
zh: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。

en: The result is that English people usually have no problem understanding what foreigners say.
zh: 结果是英国人平时没问题听得懂外国人说的话。

en: The roads are slippery on a rainy day. Be careful not to fall.
The room hasn't been cleaned recently, so it now has a foul aroma.
zh: 这个房间最近都没打扫过，有一股臭味。

en: The room was jam-packed with reporters waiting for the press conference to begin.
zh: 房间挤满了等待发布会开始的记者。

en: The rooms in this hotel are not as clean as the rooms in that hotel.
zh: 这个旅馆的房间不像那个旅馆的房间那么干净。

en: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
zh: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。

en: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
zh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。

en: The Soyuz spacecraft undocked from the International Space Station at 9:53 p.m. EDT, carrying three people back to Earth.
zh: 联盟号宇宙飞船于美国东部时间晚上9点53分脱离国际空间站，携带3人返回地球。

en: The speaker didn't know his subject, nor did he speak well; in short, he was disappointing.
zh: 演讲者不熟悉他的主题，说得又不好，总之，他很糟糕。

en: The speed at which native speakers of other languages are adding sentences doesn't even compare to theirs.
zh: 其它母语的使用者添加句子的速度也比不过他们的。

en: The staff in this shop are really friendly; no wonder they've got so many customers.
zh: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。

en: The staff in this shop are really friendly. It's no wonder they've got so much custom.
zh: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。

en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
zh: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。

en: Tom wants to talk to Mary, but she is always on the phone.
zh: 汤姆想和玛丽亚讲话，但她一直在打电话。

en: Tom went swimming in the river, but when he got out, his clothes had been stolen.
zh: 汤姆去河里游泳，但当他出来时，他的衣服被偷了。

en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
zh: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

en: Tom wrote Mary a long letter, but he didn't send it to her.
zh: 汤姆给玛丽写了封长信，可是没有寄给她。

en: Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.
zh: 汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。

en: Tomorrow there will be no normal lessons, in view of the athletic meet rehearsal.
zh: 明天是运动会的排练，没有往常的课程。

en: Trams will link the area to Edinburgh's city centre (which is only two miles away).
zh: 电车会把这个地区连接于爱丁堡的城市中心（离那里只有两英里）。

en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。

en: Turning to the right, you will find the city hall in front of you.
zh: 向右转，你就可以看到市政厅位于正前方。

en: Turpan is indeed very hot. Even the government is unable to control the temperature.
zh: 吐鲁番实在太热了，连政府也控制不了这里的温度。

en: Two men are trying to get a handle on what's wrong with the car.
zh: 两个男人在检查汽车出了什么故障。

en: Use interrogative pronouns to rewrite the sentences below; if you need to, you can add or remove a few words.
zh: 用疑问代词表任指格式改写下面的句子，根据需要可以增加或者减少一些词语。

en: Visiting one of Shanghai's recently developed parks and green spaces is also exciting!
zh: 去上海新建的绿地玩也特有劲！

en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

en: Was this wall built to keep people out or to keep them in?
zh: 建造这堵墙是为了把人隔在外面还是把他们留在里面？

en: We cannot tell a good person from a bad one by looks alone.
zh: 分辨一个人是好人还是坏人不能仅凭外表。

en: We have to be there an hour in advance to get our tickets.
zh: 咱们的票是得提前一小时去取得。

en: We've got to wait for them to finish playing - there's still a while to go!
zh: 要等它踢完啊，有一点时间啦！

en: Welcome. Now that many people have arrived, please take a seat and wait for a while.
zh: 欢迎光临，现在人很多，请坐下来等一等。

en: What are you going to do when the one you love does not love you.
zh: 当你爱的人不爱你怎么办？

en: What color is your urine: clear, dark yellow, reddish, or brown like beer?
zh: 你的尿液是什么颜色的：浅色的、深黄色的、浅红色的还是像啤酒一样的咖啡色？

en: What conditions must a child meet to be able to learn the piano?
zh: 孩子学钢琴要具备哪些条件？

en: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?
zh: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？

en: What do you think was the most read article this year on the Japanese version of Wikipedia?
zh: 你认为今年在维基百科上被最多人阅读的日文版本的文章是哪篇？

en: What is two to the power of four multiplied by three plus four squared plus three?
zh: 2的4次方乘3加4的平方加3是多少？

en: What kind of reaction did you have when he came looking for you?
zh: 他来找你的时候，当时你是什么反应？

en: What matters in life is not where you are but where you are headed.
zh: 人生重要的不是所站的位置，而是所朝的方向。

en: What place on Earth could be better than the place your people came from?
zh: 世界上有什么地方能比得上你的故乡好啊？

en: What places are you planning to visit in your travels? And how? And why?
zh: 你打算去哪些地方旅行？怎么去？为什么？

en: What's the point of showing up on time if everyone else shows up late?
zh: 为什么要准时抵达，毕竟大家都迟到。

en: When a woman is talking to you, listen to what she says with her eyes.
zh: 当一位女性在和你说话，要看着她的眼睛来聆听她的话。

en: When an Uyghur met a Belarusian, what language did the two speak to each other?
zh: 当维吾尔人遇到白俄罗斯人时，他们用什么语言沟通？

en: When considering the party, what kind of clothes are you going to wear?
zh: 参加派对的话，你会穿哪一件衣服？

en: When he asked who had broken the window, all the boys put on an air of innocence.
zh: 当他问道是谁打碎了玻璃时，所有的男孩子们都装作一副无辜的样子。

en: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
zh: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。

en: When it comes to animals, this can't be considered as being something cruel.
zh: 对动物来说这不是什么残酷的事情。

en: When many enemies appear in front of you, look back, you have many allies as well.
zh: 在前面有很多敌人的时候，还是回头看一眼。朋友的话也是很多的。

en: When Mary was spoken to by a stranger, she was at a loss for words.
zh: 当一个陌生人来和玛丽说话时，她不知道该说什么了。

en: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
zh: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。

en: When Sir Alex Ferguson saw that his players were getting tired, he always substituted them.
zh: 当亚历克斯·弗格森看到自己的球员劳累时，他总是叫替补上场。

en: When the ball was dead, Luis ran up to the ball and booted it.
zh: 在死球期间，路易斯跑向球，一脚踢上去。

en: When the goalkeeper touched the ball, the referee awarded the other team a corner kick.
zh: 守门员用手碰到了球，裁判给了对方一个角球。

en: When the great way is followed, the world is for the common good.
When the World Wildlife Fund was founded in 1961, it took the panda as its symbol.
zh: 国际野生动物基金在一九六一年创办的时候，以熊猫为象征。

en: When they were in Leicester, it was obvious that they had a very warm relationship.
zh: 在莱斯特的时候很明显她们有很热烈的关系。

en: When Tom woke up, he found Mary reading a book at the desk.
zh: 汤姆醒来的时候看到玛丽在书桌前看一本书。

en: When using the escalator, please hold the handrail and stand within the yellow line.
zh: 在乘坐扶梯时，请握住扶手，并站在黄线内。

en: When Vin Diesel does pushups, he's not pushing himself up - he's pushing the Earth down.
zh: 冯迪索在做俯卧撑时，并不是把自身往上推，而是在把地球向下推。

en: When watching TV, please ensure that the room is brightly lit and watch from a distance.
zh: 看电视的时候请确保屋子够亮，观看时保持距离。

en: When you are cheerful, books can increase your happiness; when you are sad, books can lessen your sorrow.
zh: 开心时，书可以给你增加快乐；忧伤时，书可以给你减少哀愁。

en: When you go abroad, it is useful to learn at least some polite phrases in the local language.
zh: 你出国的时候学一些当地的礼貌用语还是很有用的。

en: When you're done with the book, put it back where you found it.
zh: 你一用完了这本书，就把它放回原来找到的地方。

en: Where programmers use semi-colons every day, the majority of people only use them in emoticons.
zh: 尽管程序设计师天天都会用到分号，大多数人只把分号用在表情中。

en: Where there is grass, there is no water. Where there is water, there is no grass.
zh: 有草的地方无水，有水的地方无草。

en: Whether the characters in a book are real or completely imaginary, they can become your friends and companions.
zh: 无论书中的人物是真实的还是完全假想的，他们能成为你的伙伴和朋友。

en: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
zh: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

en: Which translation of this book do you think is better? The French one or the English one?
zh: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

en: While dreams cannot tell you what will happen to you in reality, they are able to convey your innermost thoughts.
zh: 梦虽然不会告诉你现实中将要发生什么，却能告诉你内心的真实想法。

en: While he was waiting for the train, he listened to music and sent text messages.
zh: 他等火车的时候，一会儿听音乐，一会儿发短信。

en: While video platforms do not explicitly ban such content, works of this type will have their traffic restricted.
zh: 虽然视频平台没有明确禁止此类内容，但这种类型的作品的流量会被限制。

en: Who doesn't know that if there's someone who loves showing off, it's him?
zh: 谁人不知，最爱卖弄的就是他！

en: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
zh: 那些说钱不能买来幸福的人，只是不知道上哪里去买而已。

en: Why did you interfere in an affair that did not concern you at all?
zh: 为什么你要干涉一件跟你完全不相干的事呢？

en: Why haven't you gone to sleep yet? You should go to sleep sooner.
zh: 为什么现在还没有睡？早些睡觉吧。

en: Why is there a red light coming out the window in the building across?
zh: 为什么对面楼的窗户里发出红光?

en: With a warm and wet climate, Guangzhou has fresh flowers all year round.
zh: 因为气候又暖和又湿润，所以广州一年到头都有花。

en: With its distinctive Chinese features, the qipao enjoys growing popularity in the international world of high fashion.
zh: 旗袍因有与众不同的特点而在国际时尚界享有与日俱增的名望。

en: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.
zh: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。

en: With the T.V. on, how can you keep your mind on your studies?
zh: 你开着电视怎么能安心学习呢？

en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
zh: 这次升级的一个明显影响是用户会被强制重置密码。

en: Wood may remain ten years in the water, but it will never become a crocodile.
zh: 木头或许能在水里呆上十年，但它终究不可能变成一条鳄鱼。

en: Work is so busy that I don't even have any time to relax.
zh: 工作很忙， 连休息的时间都没有。

en: Worries are like ghosts - those who aren't afraid of them can't suffer at their hands.
zh: 忧愁就像魔鬼：谁不怕它，它就不能伤害谁。

en: Xiaolin's eyebrows are thick, his eyes are big, and his eyelashes are long.
zh: 小林的眉毛长得浓，眼睛又大，睫毛很长。

en: You can add sentences that you do not know how to translate. Perhaps someone else will know.
zh: 你可以添加你不知道怎么翻译的句子，或许别人会知道。

en: You can only make local calls from the room; you can go to the front desk to call long-distance.
zh: 在房间里只能拨市内，长途可以到总台来打。

en: You can search sentences containing a certain word and get translations for these sentences.
zh: 你们可以搜索含有某个词的句子并得到这些句子的翻译。

en: You can search words, and get translations. But it's not exactly a typical dictionary.
zh: 你们可以搜索词并得到翻译。但这真不是一本寻常的字典。

en: You can take a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.
zh: 你可以把马带到河边可是不能迫它喝水。

en: You can write a sentence in a lot of ways and still keep the general message intact.
zh: 同一个含义可以用很多不同方式写的句子来表示。

en: You can't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
zh: 你不能因为她所犯下的一个错误就否定她所做的一切。

en: You can't judge a person by appearance, just as you can't measure the sea with a pint pot.
zh: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量。

en: You could at least try to be a bit more polite, even though it's not like you.
zh: 无论你平时怎么大大咧咧的，起码试着稍微礼貌一点吧。

en: You don't need to tell Tom how to do it. He already knows.
zh: 你不用告诉汤姆该怎么做。他已经知道了。

en: You have so many experiences, so could you tell me how old you are?
zh: 你有这么多的生活阅历，敢问你年方几何？

en: You have to make sure that Tom and Mary don't do that again.
zh: 你一定要确保汤姆和玛丽不再重蹈覆辙了。

en: You just can't stand still, huh? What are you, looking for a fight?
zh: 你又皮发痒了，找抽，是吧？

en: You know so many things about the Chinese language... It's just as if you were Chinese yourself.
zh: 你知道那么多关于中文的东西，就好像你是中国人一样啊。

en: You may write in any language you want. On Tatoeba, all languages are equal.
zh: 你可以用任何你想要用的语言写。在Tatoeba，所有语言都是平等的。

en: You might get fired if you do that the way Tom told you to.
zh: 你要是照着汤姆告诉你的办法做，你有可能会被开除的。

en: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.
zh: 对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。

en: You need to hand in a few photos, fill in a form, and get a visa.
zh: 你要交几张照片，填好几张表格，办好签证。

en: You should be able to judge when you've had too much to drink.
zh: 你应该自己判断什么时候喝了太多酒。

en: You should be more careful with respect to how you talk to those people.
zh: 关于用什么方式和那些人说话，你要谨慎一些。

en: You should do that as often as you can while you're still young.
zh: 趁你还年轻的时候，你应该尽可能经常地这样做。

en: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
zh: 你应该多接触本文化，多了解一些传统习俗。

en: You should use words to make sentences, rather than try to learn them with rote memorisation.
zh: 你应该宁可用词汇来造句，也不要试着死记硬背。

en: You shouldn't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
zh: 你不能因为她所犯下的一个错误就否定她所做的一切。

en: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
zh: 你的歌声像太平洋的海水一样清澈。

en: You stay up until two in the morning. You're such a night owl!
zh: 两点怎么还不睡觉，你这个夜猫子！

en: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
zh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。

en: You will need to bring two passport-sized photos of yourself taken with a white background.
zh: 您需要带两张本人的白底报名照。

en: You yourself belong to this group of people that you're talking about - the one that doesn't speak standard Mandarin well.
zh: 你说普通话不好的包括你自己。

en: You'll have to get a move on if you want to catch the train.
zh: 要想赶上火车就动作快点。

en: You'll never be able to revive someone who is only pretending to be dead.
zh: 你永远都无法救活一个装死的人。

en: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?
zh: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？

en: You're holding the book upside-down. This is upside-down and this is right-side up.
zh: 你把书拿反了，这是反面，这才是正面。

en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

en: You're really the best when, and only when, it comes to angering people.
You've got to be some special kind of crazy to like this crap.
zh: 你一定是疯了才会喜欢上这破烂。

en: Your body was always very healthy; why are you suddenly in the hospital?
zh: 你身体一直非常好，怎么突然间住医院了？

en: Your home is such a mess! When was the last time you cleaned it?
zh: 你家好脏啊！你多久没打扫卫生？

en: Your stomach has been rumbling for quite a while now. Are you sure you're all right?
zh: 刚才你肚子一直在叫，没事吧？

en: Zhejiang Province is located on the southeastern coast of China and belongs to the East China region.
zh: 浙江省地处中国东南沿海，隶属于华东地区。
